title: Mercury transaction webhook (hook request and result) shared definitions
description: Shared $defs for Milkshake Story 9.6 (docs/farm-commands.md section 16): the minimal hook request farm-command-bridge builds from an authentic Mercury webhook delivery and signs with its own mercury-hook-* key (16.4), and the data shape of the three billing.transaction.* result events milkshake-farm-consumer publishes (16.7.6). Ids, types and instants only: never an amount, a counterparty, a note, a description or a category. Patterns are anchored with ^...$.

instant.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ in UTC: six fraction digits, always.

hook_request.description: The request farm-command-bridge builds from one authentic Mercury delivery and signs (docs/farm-commands.md 16.4). Every key is always present: an optional Mercury field is null, never a missing key. Canonical form as section 2.2 (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8).

command_id.description: uuid5(NS_MERCURY_HOOK, "event:" + event_id); equals the envelope command_id.

endpoint_id.description: The Mercury webhook endpoint whose signing secret verified the delivery.

event_id.description: Mercury's event id, lowercased: Mercury's dedupe key.

resource_type.description: Only transaction events are published; the bridge archives the rest as ignored.

resource_version.description: Mercury's resourceVersion; null when absent or unreadable.

occurred_at.description: Mercury's occurredAt in UTC; null when absent or unparseable.

created_at.description: mergePatch.createdAt when present and parseable (undocumented by Mercury); else null.

posted_at.description: mergePatch.postedAt when present, non-null and parseable; else null.

changed_paths.description: Mercury's changedPaths, unique and sorted by code point: field names, never values. Null when absent or not such a list.

mercury_body_sha256.description: sha256 of the raw Mercury body, archived by the bridge as evidence.

received_at.description: The bridge's clock at receipt; equals the envelope time.

key_id.description: A key of the mercury-hook purpose: a farm-invoice-* or farm-command-* key never signs a hook request.

value.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical JSON bytes of request.

hook_result.description: The data of billing.transaction.recorded, .denied and .failed (docs/farm-commands.md 16.7.6): one shape, every key present. Never an amount, a counterparty, a note or a category.

command_id.description: Null only when the envelope could not be read.

event_id.description: Null only when the envelope could not be read.

endpoint_id.description: Null only when the envelope could not be read.

resource_id.description: Null only when the envelope could not be read.

status.description: recorded carries synced or covered, denied refused, failed failed. The bridge's ignored deliveries never reach the bus.

code.description: The refusal or failure code (docs/farm-commands.md 16.12); on synced, the failure that followed the committed sync, else null.

batch_id.description: The batch that synced it, or for covered the batch whose read covered it.

since.description: The read window start; null with read_at set means a full read.

read_at.description: When the syncing or covering read began.

tagged.description: Autotag proposals appended (0 when autotag did not run); null when covered, refused or failed.

pushed.description: Every Farm push succeeded (true), one failed (false), none was due (null).
